_note: Tags and descriptions verified by eye on a contact sheet, not guessed from filenames — this is what the planner reads to choose a photo, so a wrong description is a wrongly-chosen slide. Source: Revervia Shoot (AKBM Oct 2025), 1500px web set, and the algae Micro Photography set. bg_fit describes the photo's OWN tonality: 'light' sits on a pale slide, 'dark' carries white text. Where a cluster is genuinely near-identical (alternate frames of one setup) the entries share wording on purpose; the planner only needs to tell the SETUPS apart.
